errorMessage: No session data found for this project.
fix: Open a Forge session and ensure the Forge Sheet skill is active. The skill writes sheet/state/[project-slug].json after each exchange.

troubleshooting.label: State file missing
troubleshooting.detail: sheet/state/[slug].json does not exist. Start a Forge session with the sheet-writing skill — it will create the file after the first exchange.

troubleshooting.label: State file unreadable
troubleshooting.detail: sheet/state/[slug].json exists but could not be parsed as JSON. This usually means the file was mid-write when last polled. The shell will retry — if this persists, check the file for corruption.

troubleshooting.label: Server not running
troubleshooting.detail: The sheet is served via ./forge serve. Run that command from the Forge repo root, then reload this page.
